title: BEACON forecast-crossing trigger gates
description: Validates config/forecast-trigger.json — the gates a FORECAST_GAUGE_CATEGORY threshold rule must clear before it fires a DRAFT alert (ADR-033 §6, FEV-9). Trigger parameters are DATA, never literals in the evaluator (ADR-012). Every gate MUST declare its own `basis` prose, so a number cannot be added or changed here without stating what grounds it. This schema is deliberately NOT an extension of schemas/threshold-rule.schema.json, which is dead and drifted from its domain type (finding F-33) — it is a live schema, pinned to the shipped config by forecast-trigger-config.test.ts.

minLikelihood.description: Optional likelihood floor. When present, a forecast reading with no classified likelihood, or one below this class, cannot fire. When absent, the likelihood gate is not applied at all.

leadTime.description: The window of remaining lead time, in hours, in which a forecast crossing is actionable. A reading with no lead time at all never fires: the DRAFT alert has to state one.

vintage.description: How old the source's own forecast issue instant may be before the reading counts as superseded.
